title: Pipeline schedules and ring attention
brief: Build a pipeline Gantt table and its bubble fraction, shard attention over a simulated ring with load-balanced causal assignment, and compare tensor, pipeline, context, and data parallelism for one long request.
hints: Build the causal mask from each token's position in the whole sequence, not from its index inside the block.
A query row with no visible key has a log-sum-exp of negative infinity. Skip that block and the merge ignores it.
Put the output back in token order. Rank r's rows came from shard_indices(r), not from rows r * n to (r + 1) * n.
A ring step waits for its busiest rank, so the critical path is the sum over steps of the maximum, not the maximum of the totals.
Stage s runs micro-batch t - s at time t. Count the idle slots in the table instead of trusting the formula.
